content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** §2.1 imposed a USD 2,000,000/year, three-year take-or-pay obligation "without reduction or termination rights" — a walk-away term that fails all three fallback elements and contradicts §12.3's acknowledgement that Customer made no minimum-volume commitment. I proposed a single surgical replacement of §2.1 with the preferred position (no minimum purchase or volume commitment; payment only for Services used or ordered), offering the 12-month/30-day-notice/true-up fallback in the comment. The exit-right argument is left to T4C to avoid double-flagging.
